Learn moreDETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionStreet Football is a fast-paced arcade sports game where football meets street fighting. Take control of unique heroes, and use powerful street skills to outplay your opponents. Score spectacular goals, perform flashy finishers, and dominate playgrounds inspired by football cultures from around the world. Challenge friends, climb international leagues, improve your characters, and build your career as a street football champion. source.title: Hello Kitty Party Land
source.evidenceText: Slide 1 of 7Comic MischiefGamesHello Kitty Party LandReleases 10/29/26VersionNintendo Switch 2EditionDigitalComic MischiefLoadingTogether with heart.Join the party at Party Land and team up with beloved Sanrio characters to play together in a variety of exciting mini games.• Immerse Yourself in the Sanrio UniverseMeet over 145 beloved characters and collect their stickers! Team up with one of 16 playable Sanrio characters and play as your own avatar or your favorite teammate. • Partner Up and Enjoy Exciting Mini GamesJump into 45+ mini games with friends, either offline or online. Take on Board Game Mode and keep the action going by playing quick Petit Games while you wait for your turn.• Customize Your AvatarDesign a character that's uniquely yours. Adjust everything from hairstyle to outfits. Unlock even more items as you progress through the game!Software description provided by the publisher.Explore this game's official websitePublisher notification(s):Pre-order now and get the following bonus content:- Bonus Avatar T-shirtGrants a T-shirt for your avatar that can be used in-game.Select a character T-shirt for your avatar from 80 designs!About this itemGame file size (estimated)5.9 GBSupported play modesTV modeTabletop modeHandheld modeNo. of playersSingle system (1-4)Online (1-4)Nintendo Account family-group lendingSupportedNintendo Switch OnlineOnline PlaySave Data CloudPlay online, access classic NES™ and Super NES™ games, and more with a Nintendo Switch Online membership.
